Notes: In our code, returns are only monotonic in quintiles 1-4, then they drop a lot in 5, perhaps consistent with OP's mv rank regressions.  In older versionsn we removed the 5th quintile, but now we keep it all in since OP did not hint at the nonmonotonicity.
Detailed Definition: GrSaleToGrOverHead = Percentage growth in sales (sale) relative to average sales of t-1 and t-2, minus percentage growth in administrative expenses (xsga) relative to average administrative expenses of t-1 and t-2. Both growth terms are calculated relative to t-1 only if t-2 is missing.
